task_description:
# Full Blog Api With Relations

Build a complete blog REST API using Prisma ORM and Express.js with SQLite.

The project is at `/home/user/myproject`. Node.js and Express are pre-installed.

Define the following schema with migrations:
- `User`: id, email (unique), name
- `Post`: id, title, content (optional), published Boolean @default(false), authorId (FK to User), createdAt DateTime @default(now())
- `Comment`: id, body, postId (FK to Post), authorId (FK to User)

Build an Express server at `server.js` with these endpoints:
- `POST /users` — create user
- `GET /users/:id/posts` — get published posts by user (include comment count)
- `POST /posts` — create post (body: `{ title, content, authorId }`)
- `PATCH /posts/:id/publish` — set `published: true`
- `POST /posts/:id/comments` — add a comment (body: `{ body, authorId }`)
- `GET /posts/:id` — get post with author and comments included

Start the server: `node server.js --port <port>`
Project path: `/home/user/myproject`
truth:
## Setup
1. `cd /home/user/myproject && npx prisma migrate dev --name init` (if not done)
2. `node server.js --port $PORT` — wait for port $PORT

## Verification Steps
1. `POST http://localhost:$PORT/users` with `{ email: 'blogger@test.com', name: 'Blogger' }` → 201, returns user with id
2. `POST http://localhost:$PORT/posts` with `{ title: 'Hello', content: 'World', authorId: <id> }` → 201, returns post
3. `PATCH http://localhost:$PORT/posts/<id>/publish` → 200, post is published
4. `POST http://localhost:$PORT/posts/<id>/comments` with `{ body: 'Nice post!', authorId: <userId> }` → 201
5. `GET http://localhost:$PORT/posts/<id>` → returns post with `author.email='blogger@test.com'` and `comments` array containing the comment
6. `GET http://localhost:$PORT/users/<id>/posts` → returns array with 1 published post

## Expected Results
- All endpoints return correct HTTP status codes.
- Relations are correctly included in GET responses.
- Start command: `node server.js --port <port>`
